item.title: Health Forum revamp prompt oversight fears for Portiuncula

item.title: €300,000 Major Projects Fund opens for 2026 applications at Galway Wind Park
item.description: The co-owners of Galway Wind Park have opened the 2026 round of the Galway Wind Park Major Projects Fund – with €300,000 available to support large-scale, community-led initiatives within 10km of the facility.
